stagingLines: [d76] 🪤 Theo is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
[d76] ◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."

[d76] 👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Stonebridge, Thornfield ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
[d76] 📓 Codex: National beat staged: lead (4 villages).
[d76] The village debates Brian Otieno. Warm, mostly. "One more pair of hands." (62% for.)
[d76] 📨 The village didn't wait for you. Brian Otieno was vouched for around the fire — they're walking.
[d76] Accepted. Brian Otieno is walking. They'll reach Haven in a few days — membership starts when they arrive, but the village already counts them.
[d76] A curious wanderer waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
[d76] That night, they bring Caitriona home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
[d76] Carlos came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
[d76] Ants march past your boot, laden. You follow them to a seep. +1L water (risky). (ant_trail)
[d76] ⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
[d76] Village meal: +2282 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
[d76] Jorge is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
[d76] Victor traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.

[d77] 📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
followLines: [d78] The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food, Snared meat. Jorge mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
[d78] 🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
[d78] "Cache by the hollow. Dried meat, clean water. I can't stay. — W."
[d78] (230 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
[d78] "The audience is watching. The gamblers are watching. Everyone's watching. No pressure."
[d78] Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
[d78] Boiled 1L. Bacteria dead. (-35 kcal, 32 ticks tending the fire.)
[d78] Drank clean water.
[d78] Equipped Hatchet (melee).
[d78] Equipped Rain Shell (torso).
[d78] You catch fragments by the fire — Victor telling Carlos about Wolfgang. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
[d78] Carlos sets out to find Theo. "Won't be long."
[d78] Victor is sweeping the hall. Someone has to.
[d78] Sunlight on your skin. You drink it. +100 kcal. (photosynthesis)
[d78] — MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
[d78] Word with the traders: Thornfield door is clear again. Whatever had them, let go.
[d78] 🎁 Jesse of Stonebridge walks in with pack-mules and full baskets: 2,863 kcal, into Haven's bins — real pieces, honestly counted. "Eat. We'll settle the books when the green comes back."
[d78] You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
[d78] 🚶 Theo is back with Sigrun.
[d78] 🪤 Sigrun is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
[d78] Sunlight on your skin. You drink it. +100 kcal. (photosynthesis)
[d78] — DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
[d78] You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
[d78] 👥 Sigrun heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
[d78] 👥 Theo walks out with Sigrun. "Nobody walks alone today."
[d78] Sunlight on your skin. You drink it. +100 kcal. (photosynthesis)
[d78] — NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
[d78] Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
[d78] Word with the traders: Emberhold door is clear again. Whatever had them, let go.
[d78] You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
